A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with acceleration a(t)=1t2, where t≥1 is the time. If the particle has position x=4 and velocity v=0 when t=1, calculate the position x of the particle at time t≥1.

a
x(t)=−ln⁡t+2t
b
 x(t)=ln⁡t−2t+4
c
x(t)=ln⁡t+2
d
x(t)=−ln⁡t+t+3
e
 x(t)=−ln⁡t+t+1
Don't Know
Submit
name: Question 12
problem: A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin $O$ with acceleration $a(t)=\frac{1}{{t}^{2}},$ where $t\ge 1$ is the time. If the particle has position $x=4$ and velocity $v=0$ when $t=1,$ calculate the position $x$ of the particle at time $t\ge 1.$
